payload.core_mechanism_summary: Sqrt decomposition: precompute sums for small moduli in 2D table dp[x][y]; for large x compute sum on the fly by iterating over array.
payload.rationale: Solution maintains a 2D array dp where dp[x][y] stores sum of elements with index ≡ y mod x for x ≤ 600, fitting dp_2d_state subtype.
